context: Two managers review an internal audit checklist
purpose: Teach: 現金/値上げ/返済/公団/商標/稼ぐ/職務/突入

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 監査チェックリストを見たんだけど、今期も現金払いの伝票が異常に多いね。
lines.en: I looked at the audit checklist, and again this quarter there are an unusually large number of cash payment slips.
lines.style: Concerned managerial tone, slightly tense but professional delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、特に営業部ですね。経費精算で現金主義が残っているのは正直まずいです。
lines.en: Yes, especially in the sales department. Honestly, it's bad that cash-based reimbursement is still lingering.
lines.style: Direct, businesslike, measured female office voice tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それと、外注先からまた商品値上げの申請が上がってきてるよ。
lines.en: Also, the supplier has submitted another product price hike request.
lines.style: Reading from a document with a methodical, even pace.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 値上げ幅次第ですが、契約書の商標権の条項も一緒に法務へ確認しましょう。
lines.en: It depends on the size of the hike, but let's also have legal check the trademark rights clause in the contract.
lines.style: Firm and slightly cautionary, with clear enunciation throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 了解。それから昔の公団向け案件で残っているローン返済も見直したい。
lines.en: Got it. I also want to revisit the loan repayment still outstanding from that old public-corporation project.
lines.style: Pensive, planning-oriented delivery with a thoughtful pause.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 返済計画は経理が来週まとめます。新規で稼ぐより先に、まず利息の圧縮が優先ですね。
lines.en: Accounting will compile the repayment plan by next week. Before earning new revenue, compressing the interest comes first.
lines.style: Analytical, slightly worried but composed and steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 同感だ。監査もいよいよ最終局面に突入するから、職務分掌の表も更新しておいて。
lines.en: I agree. The audit is finally entering its final phase, so please also update the segregation of duties table.
lines.style: Decisive, wrapping-up tone carrying quiet authority and finality.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。各担当の職務範囲を整理して、明日の朝礼で共有します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll organize each person's scope of duties and share it at tomorrow's morning meeting.
lines.style: Crisp, affirmative, professional closing with confident pacing.
